section.label: Exhibit 01
section.title: The Gallery of Her
section.lede: Every wall in this room is just an excuse to look at you a little longer. Some of these are my favorite versions. Some are just you, being you.
section.hint: Click a frame — or a name below — to look closer.

photos.title: The Smile I Keep Coming Back To
photos.caption: Your cheeks puff up a little, and your eyes smile too.
photos.message: There's something about your smile that I never get tired of. The way your cheeks puff up a little and your eyes smile along with you — it's such a small thing, but it's the version of you I remember most. You look so pretty when you're genuinely happy, and I wish you could see yourself the way I see you in those moments.

photos.title: A Quiet Kind of Beautiful
photos.caption: You don't need the room's attention. You already know who you are.
photos.message: I love how independent you are. You don't need constant attention or someone telling you what to do — you have your own way of carrying yourself, your own opinions, your own direction. There's a quiet confidence in that, and it's one of the things I admire most about you. You don't follow just to follow. You decide, and then you move.

photos.title: The Version of You I Adore
photos.caption: Once you decide, you're all in.
photos.message: One of my favorite things about you is how sure you can be. Once you decide on something, you put your whole heart into it. You don't waver just because it's hard, and you don't let other people talk you out of what you know is right for you. I love that determination in you. It's steady, it's honest, and it's one of the reasons I trust you so much.

photos.title: The Girl Who Stole My Heart
photos.caption: Warm, steady, and somehow always exactly what I need.
photos.message: What got me first was how much you care. You have this warm way of looking after the people you love, and it shows in the smallest things. You're not the clingy type, which is exactly why the rare moments when you hold on a little tighter feel so special to me. I don't take those moments for granted. I just feel lucky that, out of everyone, I get to be the one you come back to.
